method.classification: Manual semantic audit of every distinct active stable concept ID, display name, and learning objective. Each exact ID is assigned once in semantic-mapping.ts; no keyword fallback or unmatched default exists.
method.primaryRule: Organ-specific recognition, workup, and treatment, including cancer management, use the organ leaf. Cross-cutting mechanisms and decision frameworks use knowledge leaves. Cross-cutting meanings remain secondary tags.
method.provenanceBoundary: These are audit inferences, not source-explicit mappings. The official outline supplies the 44-leaf audit frame; it does not map repository IDs or establish individual-topic frequency.

limitations: Coverage shares describe this 271-objective prototype bank, not exam frequency or learner need.

All candidate slots require source and duplicate review before draft authoring; clinical content remains needs_clinician_review until a named clinician approves that version for an approved public release.

generatedInventoryMethod: Enumerated actual structured concept exports from packages/clinical-content/src/index.ts and the explicitly imported PILOT_REGISTRY; compared stable IDs to SYNTHETIC_CLINICAL_RELEASE.concepts. Backlog reasons come from exported APPROVED_BACKLOG records, not text scanning.
generatedInventoryLimitations: This is not a corpus-wide string scan. It intentionally excludes unexported private constants, comments, prose, test-only literals, and raw source text that cannot be established as an authored concept record.
A same-ID historic/source record is not evidence of a second objective and must not be counted as generated-only coverage.
No claim of clinical approval, current evidence, or runtime feasibility follows from an unadmitted record.
